usedFor: A completed Zoom meeting summary shares a Google Drive file with attendees as a link.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting summary is completed” in Zoom, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A summary appears once the meeting ends, which is when a shared file is useful.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” makes the file reachable by link, so choose Viewer unless people must edit.
